_doc: Rules for ops_watch.py (the Dispatcher's deterministic measurement arm, V3_ROLES_BUILD_EIGHT_CHAIRS_ONE_TABLE). Keys are glob patterns over point keys (family.name). Only MEASURED points feed the band, run and silent rules; a target names the marks it accepts. A target with alarm true files one rimflow item when the condition is NEW, and re-arms only after it clears. Its optional worse is the stated step ({"factor": 2}: doubled; {"add": 50}: 50 further, in the direction its op calls worse) past which an alarm still crossed is raised again (a note, a Conductor line, a fresh Operations run); a rise in severity does that with no step.

queues.name: designer
queues._doc: DESIGNER_STALL_MONITOR_READY_AND_FORGOTTEN: a concept whose stage.json reads status=ready waits on a run-now launch nobody schedules; pending since it last moved, the oldest ready concept's wait; DESIGNER_ANSWERED_MONITOR_WAITING_ON_NOBODY: a waiting_owner concept whose owner has answered (designer_stage.owner_moved) is pending too, since his answer; the Designer's off switch pauses it

steve_seats._doc: c_steve_seats: a seat is up when its tmux screen shows `ready`

seats._doc: c_seats (OP2 in operating_requirements_2026-11-01.md), read from the Dispatcher's journal.jsonl and state.json under RM_DISPATCHER_STATE or state_dir. Every limit is in the ranges block. Bringing the seat back is DI1's, not this metric's
seats._journal_grace_s_doc: rm-dispatcher.service's TimeoutStartSec: a tick that holds a ring in state.json has journalled it or died by then

roles.Operations.acted_share.why: RO1: the share of Operations's outputs somebody later acted on. Report-only and coarse: under range two weeks running gets a named fix of its input or its reader from the Conductor, and nothing rings. 0.25 is a first line, set by hand from the 2026-11-01 reading, not a target.

ranges._doc: OP1 in operating_requirements_2026-11-01.md: the watched metrics' classes as data, read by the collectors and by ops_watch.run, which stamps class, owner, ack_within_min and max_age_min on each reading. A metric fills only the classes it can act on, of idle, sane, distressed, emergency (roles.* alone: under, sane; under rings nothing, RO1 is report-only); every class is one of {"at_least": n}, the class of a reading from n up to the next class's n, or {"in": [text]} with one {"otherwise": true}. owner: who answers for it. ack_within_min: required with distressed or emergency. max_age_min: an older source reads UNMEASURED. idle_if: this metric reads idle while any metric named here does. why: a range change rewrites it. `ops_watch.py lint` and load_rules refuse a metric short of any of these. classes: a limit lives here and nowhere else

disk.scratch_outside_cap.why: OP2: 279 clones once sat outside the pool cap, which counts relentless/clones alone. The reading is rm_scratch_clones in the newest phase of scratch_reap's sanity record. Distressed one past that record's start line of 12 (near twice a quiet machine); the selftest holds the two equal. max_age_min: two hourly reaper starts plus the timer's 5 min jitter and a margin, so one missed run is not an alarm and two are.

disk.scratch_outside_blind.why: The sanity record is missing, torn, stale or holds no reading: nothing can say the clones are inside the cap. Agrees with the disk.scratch_outside_blind target.

disk.root_fall_gb.why: GROWER_ALARM_WIRE_NOBODY_READS_IT: fall_gb in the newest row of ~/.local/state/rm-scratch-reap/growth.jsonl (disk_grower, every rm-scratch-pressure tick of 10 min): how far the root fell below its peak in the grower's 30-min window AND is still down a tick later (held_fall_gb: peak minus the higher of this reading and the one before; OPS_ROOT_GROWER_MEASURE_CAUGHT_WRITING_QMOX, 2026-11-06: Relentless's walled-box churn swung free 750 -> 704 -> 750 -> 708 GB, reaped within a tick, and the raw fall alarmed on it; a row from before reads fall_gb). On 2026-11-04 it fell 578 -> 140 GB at ~3.3 GB/min, ~33 GB a tick, with pool and scratch flat, and the writer vanished unnamed. Distressed at disk_grower.FALL_GB (30), the line at which it captures; the selftest holds the two equal. max_age_min: three ticks.

disk.root_fall_blind.why: growth.jsonl is missing, torn, stale or holds no fall_gb: nothing would name a fast root grower. Agrees with the disk.root_fall_blind target.

queues.artpipe.stalled_min.why: QUEUE_ORPHAN_WEDGE_1: pending jobs with no claim, finish or heartbeat for 20 min. The daemon sat IDLE with 37 pending for 17 h behind an orphaned active/ job and a latched sandbox check.

queues.testq.stalled_min.why: QUEUE_ORPHAN_WEDGE_1: testq pending with nothing running or finishing for 20 min (a paused.json reads 0).

queues.designer.stalled_min.why: DESIGNER_STALL_MONITOR_READY_AND_FORGOTTEN: a concept at status=ready with no Designer run for 60 min. The Designer is run-now only, so nothing launches it (FlowWorks sat at stage 2 ready from 2026-11-04 13:02Z for 12 h+ while 14 FlowWorks build items were concept_refused); measured runs take 2 to 11 min. DESIGNER_ANSWERED_MONITOR_WAITING_ON_NOBODY: a waiting_owner concept whose owner has answered counts from his answer, since only a run's open moves it back to ready.

queues.blind.why: A queue whose directories cannot be listed: nothing can say it is moving.

seats.paused.why: A PAUSE file is a stop somebody chose: seats.idle_with_work_min reads idle, never distressed.

seats.tick_age_s.why: last_ok_tick in state.json. Older than max_age_min the source is frozen and seats.blind says so, so no class above sane is needed. The tick runs every 2 min.

seats.idle_with_work_min.why: DI1's 30 min, the owner's limit for FOUNDRY idle with work ready; the 2026-10-31 run crossed it at 14:44Z, before the idle_full_queue alarm of 14:55Z. Emergency at 2 h, four times that line.

seats.blind.why: The state or journal is missing, frozen or disagreeing: nothing can say the seats are sane. Agrees with the seats.blind target.

roles._doc: RO1, role_use.py: how the ledger shows a role's outputs. Report-only: the metric gates nothing and is no target. marked: the words a role's own output carries. coarse: the design's first reading of a role's items, a file event's why opening with the word; reported beside the marked count, acted_share does not use it. action_events: what counts as somebody acting on an item; a note, raise, lease or reassign moves no work.

steve_incident._doc: item-id prefix of the steward's escalation items (testq/steward.py); steve.incident_unclaimed_min is the age of the oldest one no seat holds; owner_rung marks an OWNER rung (the steward's T+120 item before STEWARD_RUNG_FIX_ASKS_THE_WRONG_GROWNUP; that rung is now a told row for Operations), no seat's to claim, never counted

band._doc: a point outside the baseline mean +/- k sigma. Baseline: the last baseline_days of MEASURED points, minus the last exclude_recent_h; needs min_points. Sigma is floored (max of sigma_floor_rel x |mean| and sigma_floor_abs) so a flat series does not flag on noise.

run._doc: n consecutive same-direction changes (equal neighbours collapse) in the KPI series named here; a drift the band cannot see yet.

silent._doc: a series that was MEASURED within the baseline and has not been MEASURED for its hours: the instrument went blind. A tokentalk.<group>.share whose group token_talk no longer lists (seats, roles) is retired, never silent (ops_watch.tt_retired).

The ticket asks for a renewal, never makes one: renewing is not an agent's own call (rimflow/companion_grant.json _why); meanwhile `rimflow next` withholds bridge/game-up work

Then grant_hours_left is UNMEASURED and its alarm holds silent, while rimflow next already withholds all bridge/game-up work: fail closed means someone is told

targets.name: OPS_NIGHTLY_RED_DIAGNOSE
targets.why: TE1: a known-red list entry past its age, or a bad entry. A red no entry parks is a build-cop group (NIGHTLY_RED), not this alarm. Drop a cured entry, renew a live one on the record, or let its red fall back to the build cop: python3 src/RimMandrake/Utils/known_reds.py report

targets.name: OPS_NIGHTLY_SWEEP_DIAGNOSE
targets.why: NIGHTLY_SWEEP_HARDEN_DIED_AT_SIXTY: a sweep that did not finish re-runs on its own; this is the night it stopped trying, or a start that did not take, and everything the nightly feeds reads an old night

targets.name: OPS_TESTQ_INGEST_REFILE
targets.why: RIMMANDRAKE_RENAME_INGEST_REPAIR_ITEMS_MINT_REFUSES_THEM: a testq done record ingest stopped retrying holds a verdict, finding or harness repair that never reached the ledger; 10 repairs were lost this way 2026-11-05..15 with no sign. Fix the refusal named in the error, then clear the record's ingested stamp so ingest files it.

targets.name: NIGHTLY_COP_FIX
targets.why: BUILD COP (RED_COP_BUILD_NO_ORPHAN_REDS), HELD with the nightly until a mod's Design Version passes (owner by card 2026-11-15; while held every group reads 0 and nothing files): nightly reds no known-red entry parks, one group per first error line. Each group is one raised item with its deadline in the title, handed to one capped detached fixer by rimflow/red_dispatch.py (rm-red-dispatch.timer; one attempt, then a Needs Conductor line); item SELFTEST_FIX_<FIRST TEST>_* (older ones NIGHTLY_COP_FIX_RED_<KEY>_*) is one group testing.red_<key> (alarms.json pairs them), whose every test `python3 src/RimMandrake/Utils/known_reds.py report` lists. Fix it (a rollback first when one commit broke it), or after known_red_after_nights nights park it: python3 src/RimMandrake/Utils/known_reds.py add <test> --item <this item> --why ...

targets.name: OPS_RED_OVERDUE_CHASE
targets.why: BUILD COP: a nightly red still red past selftest.red_fix_deadline_h from the first night of its streak, owned or not (an item makes a red owned, never fixed). Only a fix or a known-red entry ends it.

targets.name: OPS_FINDINGS_DIAGNOSE
targets.why: findings filed UNTRIAGED with no outcome past one judge cycle (ops_watch.UNTRIAGED_GRACE_S; a younger one waits for the daily findings judge by design): no same-named item, spawn --from, ledger retype or findings_fold decide (findings design section 3)

alarm._doc: Filing: spawn as RUNNER from the dispatch clone (its testq/ingest.py: rimflow + publish) under QHOME/ingest.lock, the lock the ingest and the Dispatcher take. RM_OPS_ALARM_CLONE / RM_OPS_ALARM_PARENT override.
alarm._for_doc: BENCH was Relentless's home pool until its retirement (2026-11-13). ops_watch and the dead-man file here only while rimflow incident.receiver_problem(for, needs) says somebody picks it up, else the alarm stays PENDING with 'no receiver' on it; every item filed or reopened is raised (first in the BENCH queue); Relentless, which drained this pool, was retired 2026-11-13, so build-cop red items go to rimflow/red_dispatch.py (RIMMANDRAKE_ROUTE_NIGHTLY_REDS_RAISED_INTO_A_RETIRED_POOL) and every other alarm item is the Conductor seat's (alarm_routes.json drainers; RIMMANDRAKE_NAME_RECEIVER_FOR_SEAT_ALARMS_PENDING_WITH_NONE)
alarm._clear_passes_doc: an open alarm clears (and re-arms) only after 4 clear readings in a row (1 h at 15 min): a reading that wobbles across its line files one item, not one per wobble. UNMEASURED readings neither clear nor reset the count (a flaky instrument must not pin an alarm open forever)

token_talk._doc: No-AI drift measure (owner 2026-10-27: only Operations analyses burn; every role but it and the Conductor is token-blind). Per seat and role: the % of its reports in window_days (ledger notes/closes by that seat, commit messages by path owner, finished role-run result text) holding at least one term. Terms are regex fragments, whole-word, case-insensitive; a bare cap is not a term (log caps, size caps), a token/daily/week/session/usage cap is. Operations is excluded (its OPS_* ledger items and its role runs). Under min_reports reports the point is UNMEASURED, never 0.
token_talk._seats_why: owner 2026-10-31: "Conductor accesses everything." Seat BENCH (the Conductor and its helpers) and the conductor role are not measured. FOUNDRY, the one seat it measured, retired (owner by card 2026-11-02); Relentless writes as RELENTLESS but every ledger reader folds that to BENCH, so no seat is measured here until a reader keeps the written name.

fleet_fit._doc: ops_watch.fleet_readings (RIMMANDRAKE_READ_FLEET_MOVED_RUNWAY_IDLE_ACCOUNT_READS_TEN): the fleet's burn is every account's meter slope summed, the faster of this short window and accounts_fit's; switching_plan.simulate runs the plan forward at it for horizon_h in step_min steps to read accounts.fleet_stop_h, and each account's moved_runway is its room above its plan line at that burn

codex._stale_h_doc: a last reading older than this is an ESTIMATE floor: Codex may be spent from another machine
